title: Host-generated evaluator and reviewer briefs still teach "git diff HEAD -- . | sha256sum" against Greg's no-manual-hashing rule
outcome: No TermAl-generated brief, refusal text or read-only allowlist example teaches or suggests hashing a diff or files (for example sha256sum) as a way to identify source. Evaluator and reviewer guidance points only at the shared source_id from engram source and plain read-only Git display commands.
acceptance: Host-generated evaluator and reviewer briefs still teach "git diff HEAD -- . | sha256sum" against Greg's no-manual-hashing rule is done
